D4·9hqv — 2026-11-17
rule: Rust pushes build incrementally from cache; anything that ships builds clean.
operator: "a, and push"
chose: On a push, CI's core and apple jobs compile incrementally on the last green push's cached target/ (actions/cache, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1). Pull requests, dispatches and release tags build from clean.
over: accepting 2.5–4 min Rust pushes, or paid larger runners
because: Compiling sofar-core took 80–130s on every hosted runner, and rust-cache never keeps workspace crates. An incremental rebuild after a fresh checkout took 2s against 20s cold. Clean builds on pull requests and tags keep a stale incremental artifact from passing anything that ships.
